headline: Bank of Korea Raises Base Rate by 25 Basis Points to 3.25%
summary: The Monetary Policy Board of the Bank of Korea raised the Base Rate by 25 basis points to 3.25% amid strengthened domestic economic growth, persistent inflation pressures, and financial stability risks.
why: The Bank of Korea is the central bank of South Korea, responsible for formulating monetary policy and maintaining financial stability.

impacts.name: South Korea Base Rate
impacts.why: The central bank officially increased its benchmark policy rate by 25 basis points.
